### ✓ 2026-06-07: Replace asserted evidential parity with "physicalism not compelled" + de-leak Davidson co-optation (duhem-quine article)
- **Type**: refine-draft
- **Notes**: From outer review 2026-06-07 (Claude Opus 4.8). Two precise, distinct edits. (a) **Parity overstatement** — the line "Neither programme can claim evidential supremacy" (currently ~line 112) asserts PARITY, a stronger conclusion than underdetermination delivers. Underdetermination shows physicalism is not *compelled*; it does not establish that the two programmes are evidentially equal (Laudan & Leplin: empirically equivalent theories can differ in evidential support). Replace the parity claim with the weaker, defensible "underdetermination shows physicalism is not forced," and elsewhere close the epistemic→metaphysical slide (insert and exclude the intervening non-dualist alternatives — type-B physicalism, Russellian monism — wherever the text moves from "physical description does not entail phenomenal experience" to "dualism"). (b) **Davidson co-optation** — the framework-dependence / "lossy translation" passage recruits Davidson as if he supported incommensurable schemes; Davidson argued the opposite (the very idea of incommensurable conceptual schemes is unintelligible — "On the Very Idea of a Conceptual Scheme," 1974). Either drop the Davidson framing or mark the disagreement honestly; do not present a dualism-favorable "lossy translation" reading as Davidson's view. Mark dualism-favorable conclusions in the "neutral" theoretical-virtues/framework-dependence passages as tenet-driven interpretations, not analysis outputs. Preserve calibration language; length-neutral.

### ✓ 2026-06-05: Mark the convergence-vs-parsimony asymmetry in concepts/epistemology.md
- **Type**: refine-draft
- **Notes**: Pessimistic review 2026-06-05 (first ever on this 1594-word hub; last deep-reviewed 2026-05-14) found a latent INTERNAL TENSION: the article dismantles parsimony as lacking "epistemic warrant in metaphysical domains" (line 67, "The parsimony assumption") while elevating convergence as conferring "warrant that no single line could provide alone" (line 83, Fourth point under "Epistemology Under Dualism"). Both are theory-virtue / IBE meta-inferences; a critic reads this as selective epistemology (reject the simplicity virtue when it cuts against dualism, embrace the convergence virtue when it cuts for it). FIX (length-neutral, 1-2 sentences): distinguish the two — convergence is evidential agreement among arguments with DIFFERENT premises, whereas parsimony is a prior over ontologies; state which precondition convergence meets that parsimony fails. SECONDARY, same pass: (a) line 83 "each provide independent evidence" overstates — the knowledge argument, conceivability, and explanatory gap arguably share one underlying intuition (omission of the qualitative), so hedge to "partially independent" and note the argument-from-reason is the genuinely distinct leg (rational causation, not qualia); settle the detail at [epistemology-of-convergence-arguments](/topics/epistemology-of-convergence-arguments/). (b) line 91 "certain about the existence and character of experience" over-reaches given documented introspective unreliability about CHARACTER — split existence-warrant (strong) from character-warrant (calibrated, fallible). (c) line 97 "stands or falls on whether its epistemological foundations hold" invites the Popperian falsifiability challenge unanswered — add a falsification condition + link [tenet-falsification-conditions](/concepts/tenet-falsification-conditions/). (d) line 67 "demonstrates that this argument fails" → "argues that this argument fails" (softer for a contested claim). Preserve the strong causal-closure-as-stipulation move and the two-channels framing — those are the article's core contributions. No "This is not X. It is Y." cliché. See [pessimistic-2026-06-05-epistemology](/reviews/pessimistic-2026-06-05-epistemology/).

### ✓ 2026-06-05: Sharpen named-opponent engagement in concepts/carrolls-regress.md
- **Type**: refine-draft
- **Notes**: Pessimistic review 2026-06-05 ([pessimistic-2026-06-05e](/reviews/pessimistic-2026-06-05e/)) found two structural issues in an otherwise strong, citation-clean concept page (Carroll *Mind* 4(14):278–280 and Polanyi *Philosophy* 41(155):1–18 both web-verified exact; Gödel "predates by 36 years" correct; no label leakage; ~1,639 body words, well under concept envelope — NOT a length task). (1) MEDIUM epistemic/metaphysical equivocation in "The Inferentialist Reading" (¶51–53) and the Dualism tenet-connection (¶71): the regress (inferentialist reading) establishes at most an *articulation/formalisation* limit ("no augmentation of *explicit* rules reproduces taking-as"), but the prose slides to a *constitutively non-formal mental operation* ("primitive operation of consciousness," "one face of the irreducibly mental") which is what the Dualism link requires — the speculation marker is attached to the Gödel resemblance, not to this epistemic→metaphysical bridge. Fix per [evidential-status-discipline](/project/evidential-status-discipline/): split the two readings explicitly and supply the bridging argument (why an articulation-limit is evidence of a constitutively non-formal operation rather than an unformalised-but-physical one), addressing the "syntactic fact ≠ cognitive claim" objection — or downgrade. (2) MEDIUM boundary-substitution in the Brandom paragraph (¶63), the only engagement with the strongest contemporary opponent: the reply "social practice is itself a tissue of individual takings" *presupposes* individual-first priority, the exact premise Brandom denies — it does not refute Brandom inside his framework. Per [direct-refutation-discipline](/project/direct-refutation-discipline/), either supply the in-framework argument (the community's conferral of an inferential licence is itself a taking-the-move-as-licensed, so the regress relocates not dissolves — without presupposing individualism) OR downgrade honestly to framework-boundary marking ("the disagreement turns on a prior commitment, not a refutation within Brandom's framework"). The Wittgenstein paragraph (¶59) already does this correctly — make Brandom inherit its discipline. Also soften "provably insufficient"/"shown to be incomplete by formal argument" (¶69) → "argued"/"on the inferentialist reading" (the reading is contested, so not *proven*); and scope the "self-stultifying" charge (¶69) to the agent-act reading (a formal calculus has no cognition to presuppose). LENGTH-NEUTRAL preferred. PRESERVE the up-front honesty ("later moves rest on the inferentialist reading being defensible, not uncontested") and the cousins-not-siblings Gödel calibration. See [pessimistic-2026-06-05e](/reviews/pessimistic-2026-06-05e/).

### ✓ 2026-06-04: Add the recall-vs-recognition DID memory-transfer counterevidence to clinical-dissociation-as-systematic-evidence.md (Marsh/Huntjens 2021)
- **Type**: refine-draft
- **Notes**: From Gemini 2.5 Pro outer review 2026-06-04 (the single genuinely-DISTINCT Gemini finding; not captured by the ChatGPT or Claude 06-04 legs). The DID section (lines 53-57) presents intra-state cognition intact + cross-state integration lost as favouring the interface reading, citing only Reinders 2003. It omits the most direct empirical counterevidence: **Marsh, Dorahy, Butler, Middleton, de Jong, Kemp & Huntjens (2021), "Inter-identity amnesia for neutral episodic self-referential and autobiographical memory in DID: An assessment of recall and recognition," *PLoS ONE* 16(2):e0245849** (VERIFIED real, correct attribution, DOI confirmed). Finding: DID patients subjectively report inter-identity amnesia on free RECALL, but objective RECOGNITION tests show significant cross-identity memory transfer (more than simulators / partial-info controls). This dissociates a metacognitive/retrieval-ownership deficit from a structural cross-state severance — i.e. the physical substrate demonstrably retains and integrates the information, so the "lost cross-state integration" claim should be qualified: the loss is at the level of executive/metacognitive access and felt ownership, not demonstrably at the substrate-integration level. FIX: add the recall/recognition distinction as a live counter-reading in the DID section; note the substrate retains the information (recognition transfer), which is exactly what a connectivity-physicalist predicts and which weakens the interface reading at this site; keep the article's two-tier "earns the architecture, not the dualist significance" calibration ([evidential-status-discipline](/project/evidential-status-discipline/)). A 2024 systematic-review/meta-analysis (ScienceDirect S0272735824001351) corroborates the transfer pattern and is an optional second anchor — WEB-VERIFY at publisher before adding (ai_citation_metadata_unreliable). Length-watch: target is length-constrained — keep the addition minimal/surgical; if it busts the ceiling, flag for human length decision rather than auto-condensing calibration content. NO mode labels ([direct-refutation-discipline](/project/direct-refutation-discipline/)).

### ✓ 2026-06-04: Fix conversion-disorder factual error in clinical-dissociation-as-systematic-evidence.md (increased, not severed, amygdala-motor coupling)
- **Type**: refine-draft
- **Notes**: From Claude Opus 4.8 outer review 2026-06-04 (VERIFIED FACTUAL ERROR, the review's headline finding, likely distinct from ChatGPT's same-day review). The article frames conversion disorder / FND as a "descending motor channel DISCONNECTING" (citing Vuilleumier 2005, Brown 2004). The modern FND literature reports the OPPOSITE: **increased** functional connectivity between amygdala and motor/supplementary-motor regions — heightened limbic *influence over* motor control, not a severed channel. Voon et al. (2010, *Brain*, "Emotional stimuli and motor conversion disorder": greater right-amygdala↔right-SMA connectivity, Granger-causal amygdala→SMA direction); Hassa et al. (2017, *NeuroImage: Clinical*, n=13 functional-hemiparesis: increased left-amygdala↔(pre-)SMA + subthalamic-nucleus connectivity). The contemporary mechanism is Edwards, Adams, Brown, Pareés & Friston (2012, *Brain* 135(11):3495-3512, "A Bayesian account of 'hysteria'"): an abnormally precise intermediate-level motor prior ACTIVELY GENERATES the symptom (aberrant precision-weighting), not a severed channel — the article's framing is closer to the discarded Freud/Janet "hysteria" picture than current FND science (Stone/Edwards/Aybek/Hallett/Perez). FIX: replace the "channel disconnect" framing with the increased-coupling / active-generation account; concede "intact motor system + functional symptom" is now explained by active generation, not disconnection. ⚠ WEB-VERIFY every cite at publisher of record before adding (Voon 2010 Brain, Hassa 2017 NeuroImage:Clinical, Edwards/Friston 2012 Brain) — full author incl given name (ai_citation_metadata_unreliable; wrong-author/dual-date caught repeatedly). ⚠ PROPAGATE to siblings inheriting the same motor-channel framing (conversion-disorder-as-consciousness-side-fault, neurological-dissociations-as-interface-architecture, dissociative-states-as-intact-substrate-interface-evidence). Benchmark that would partly rehabilitate the disconnect framing: a post-2015 replication showing *reduced* prefrontal-motor connectivity as dominant FND signature.

### ✓ 2026-06-03: Fix Han & Choi (2016) citation gloss in brain-internal-born-rule-testing.md
- **Type**: refine-draft
- **Notes**: Pessimistic review (pessimistic-2026-06-03-brain-internal-born-rule-testing) found a load-bearing CITATION GLOSS defect in §"What the Corridor Is" (L55). The text attributes to Han & Choi (2016) the claim that "the per-trial information-theoretic capacity of such channels vanishes asymptotically as the number of trials grows." WEB-VERIFIED: the cite is REAL (Sci. Rep. 6:22986; arXiv:1307.2026) but the paper does NOT prove this — it derives the Born rule from a strengthened relativistic-causality condition and bounds quantum nonlocality; there is no per-trial, trials-indexed capacity-vanishing theorem. This is a possibility→theorem upgrade (an informal corollary dressed as a proven information-theoretic result), exactly what [evidential-status-discipline](/project/evidential-status-discipline/) guards against. FIX (surgical — do NOT disturb surrounding calibrated prose): downgrade to the qualitative claim the source actually supports — Born-deviating probability assignments under their causality condition enable superluminal signalling, so a strictly Born-compliant selection channel transmits no ensemble-level information (this is also exactly what the article's Torres Alegre 2025 cite proves: Φ(p)=p unique under no-signalling). Do NOT assert-fabricated and do NOT delete the cite — the paper is genuine; only its gloss is wrong. Article conclusion survives on the qualitative argument. The other three hot-zone cites (Torres Alegre arXiv:2512.12636, Arana 2025 PhilArchive ARATCQ-2, Kerskens & López Pérez 2022) were verified genuine — leave them.

Estimated scope: medium (~2,000 words). Tenet alignment: Dualism (irreducible insight resisting computational search) and Bidirectional Interaction (insight producing checkable physical proofs). ### ✓ 2026-06-03: Close the van Inwagen life→consciousness gap on the biological route in consciousness-and-the-metaphysics-of-composition.md
- **Type**: refine-draft
- **Notes**: From outer review 2026-06-03 (Gemini 2.5 Pro), Sections 3.1 & weakness #5 — the ONE genuinely new finding from the Gemini leg (the rest CONVERGED with the ChatGPT+Claude tasks above; see this review's `## Verification Notes`). The biological route (van Inwagen) in the convergence argument treats van Inwagen's organicism as a "route to consciousness," but van Inwagen's actual composition criterion is **metabolic/homeostatic/teleological life-unity, NOT phenomenal consciousness**. The article relies on an undefended bridge premise: that *all and only living things are conscious* (biopsychism/panbiotism). Plants, fungi, and single-celled organisms are living composites on van Inwagen's view yet are not phenomenally conscious subjects in the sense the unity/interaction argument needs — so the biological route reaches *life-unity*, and only reaches *consciousness* via an unstated, contestable identification. This is the same "convergence only after redescription / equivocation on 'consciousness'" structure the ChatGPT+Claude legs flagged for the IIT and Merricks routes (the convergence-calibration P2 above), but applied specifically to the van Inwagen leg — so COORDINATE with that task (it is the natural home for this if the refine touches the convergence framing; keep as a distinct sub-point so it isn't lost). FIX (length-neutral): where the biological route is introduced, either (a) explicitly state and defend/qualify the life→consciousness bridge (note that van Inwagen himself defends a *materialist* ontology of persons — do not recruit him as a consciousness-criterion proponent without caveat, cf. the parallel McQueen & Tsuchiya living-author-misattribution P1 above), or (b) recast the route as reaching *organic/causal unity* that the Map then argues is consciousness-involving, marking that second step as a Map-internal move rather than van Inwagen's. Apply the [direct-refutation-discipline](/project/direct-refutation-discipline/) remit: this is most likely an honest framework-boundary / unsupported-foundational-move case (the article has not earned "life = consciousness" by van Inwagen's own standards) — reply in natural journal-quality prose per [writing-style](/project/writing-style/), NO mode labels in the body. Honour [evidential-status-discipline](/project/evidential-status-discipline/) and ai_citation_metadata_unreliable (van Inwagen = living author; verify any attributed position). Gemini (weakness 5): the text "completely ignores Illusionism... the void is merely the functional shadow of the brain's data-compression architecture" and HOT, under which "the 'added content' [of introspection] is the very thing that turns a biologically unconscious physiological state into a conscious experience." ChatGPT (§3): "higher-order and global-workspace-style theories deserve explicit engagement... reportability, availability, access, or metacognitive monitoring are not merely contaminating additions; they are part of what makes a state conscious." The right move is a mix of (a) in-framework engagement where the deflation can be met on its own terms — e.g. HOT and the void's thesis are partly *complementary* (both agree introspection adds structure; they disagree on whether anything conscious exists below it), so state precisely where the disagreement bites rather than ignoring HOT; and (b) honest framework-boundary-marking where it cannot — illusionism denies the explanandum (phenomenal "what-it's-like") the Map takes as given under [dualism](/tenets/#dualism), so name that as a bedrock disagreement, NOT a refutation. Do NOT let the article's existing dualist commitment silently *close* the question against these competitors; present them as live alternatives the void is underdetermined between, then state the Map's reasons for its reading. Add a compact "Deflationary Alternatives" passage (or fold into the planned "What Would Challenge This View?" section from the ChatGPT task — coordinate to avoid duplication). Apply reply modes in natural journal-quality prose ([writing-style guide](/project/writing-style/)); do NOT expose mode labels in the body — classification goes in the changelog.
